test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
How many triangles are there in the following figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e5a72cc6ba17d844cb0f30e6f9b13f5ecf07a3912f5c8c3907e51eb1c598bf2.png]
solution:
The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below:

1) Number of triangles = (Number of parts × Number of diagonals)

= 4 × 2 ⇒ 8 

Here, as there are 3 same parts, therefore '8 × 3' = 24 triangles

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db57d8442bc80c4562763b91eeaea6e9e878dd34e6da127e6fbcf531855f03a0.png] 

2) Number of triangles as marked = 4

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0619f3a1db98f709b85ea6a6d47bb01fae1c24df17f64d3f0de5da6130000988.png] 

Thus, total number of triangles are 24 + 4 = 28

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
